ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface area against a low-intensity black perimeter and notch region, producing a high macro-level contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and lateral regions consist of a contiguous high-intensity white block. Low-intensity black pigmentation is mapped as a continuous border along the trailing edge, a central vertical column at the median notch, and several isolated circular focal spots on the mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an estimated internal pixel angle of 42 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending approximately 15% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations observed across the entire linear boundary. Variations exhibit a peak-to-valley amplitude of 3-7 pixels, with significantly increased topographic irregularity and macro-serrations at both distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a broad convex curve from the notch to the distal regions, terminating in a sharp upward sweep at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of low-contrast yellowish-tan pixels are visible on the lower-left and lower-right white surfaces. High-contrast white clusters are detected on the dark-pigmented distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct low-intensity linear disruptions are detected on the right lobe: one horizontal mark mid-lobe and one shorter vertical mark near the upper trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent horizontal dark linear scar on the right lobe; irregular dark spot/marking on the upper-inner quadrant of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The transition zone between black edge pigmentation and the white lobe surface is characterized by a 'frayed' appearance, with small, sharp low-intensity spikes protruding into the high-intensity regions.
